A comparative flowchart illustrating the Parliamentary system and the Presidential system. On the left (First Republic), a box for Parliament points down to the Prime Minister and Cabinet, showing they are drawn from the legislature. On the right (Second Republic), the Electorate points separately to the Executive President and the National Assembly (Senate and House of Representatives), showing the separation of powers.

A timeline of the Second Republic, 1979–1983. 1979: Shagari sworn in, new 1979 Constitution begins. 1980: Green Revolution launched. 1981: NPN-NPP Accord breaks down; Impeachment of Balarabe Musa. 1982: Economic Stabilization Act (Austerity Measures) introduced. 1983: General elections held (August); Military coup ends the Republic (December 31).
